title: IPFS CIDv1 Computer
description: Computes a CIDv1 (Content Identifier version 1) for any file upload or text input in the browser using WebCrypto SHA-256. Outputs the CID string in base32 lowercase multibase encoding (RFC 4648, 'b' prefix) and displays the full multihash breakdown: function code (0x12), digest length (0x20), digest hex, CID bytes hex, and annotated byte-level breakdown. Supports raw (0x55) and dag-pb (0x70) codecs. No pinning, no upload, no network calls. Use to verify what tokenURI a file will resolve to on IPFS before minting.

text.description: Text content to compute CID for (alternative to file upload)

codec.description: Multicodec: raw (0x55) for unstructured bytes, dag-pb (0x70) for UnixFS

cid.description: CIDv1 string in base32 lowercase multibase (starts with 'b')
